# sreagent_deploy_policies (Data Source)

Every deploy_policy row, read-only. A per-service deploy gate policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_deploy_policies" "all" {}

output "deploy_policies_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_deploy_policies.all.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `burn_rate_block_enabled` (Boolean) Hold deploys while an SLO burns faster than its threshold.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is in force.
- `error_budget_threshold` (Number) Hold deploys while less than this percent of an SLO's error budget is left, 0 to 100; 0 turns the budget block off.
- `freeze_reason` (String) Why the service is frozen.
- `freeze_until` (String) When the current freeze ends.
- `frozen` (Boolean) Whether a freeze is in force now.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `incident_block_enabled` (Boolean) Hold deploys while an incident is open for the service.
- `override_active` (Boolean) Whether an audited override is in force.
- `override_allow` (Boolean) The stored override flag; override_active says whether it is in force now.
- `override_by` (String) Who took the override.
- `override_until` (String) When the override ends.
- `service` (String) The service this policy gates.
